messages:
ana: Quick heads-up — runtime-3.4 cutover scheduled for 22:00 PT tonight. Posting pre-deploy checklist here, please ack ownership for each item.

matt: I'll own the canary rollout and traffic ramp plan.

liam: I'll run the smoke suite and perf spot checks at canary. What failures should I prioritize?

ana (typo correction): (sorry) ana: prioritize 502s, long-tail P95 > 600ms, and incorrect generation regressions flagged by evals.

rebecca: I'll be standby for DB migrations and feature-flag toggles. Will monitor DB replica lag.

jess: I'll be rollback owner — have the rollback runbook ready and tested on staging. Will be oncall 21:45-23:30 PT.

deploy-bot: Deploy plan created: https://redwood/ops/deploys/3332109876 
- canary: 1% -> 10% over 10m -> 30% over 20m
- smoke suite hook: eng-sre/smoke-runner -> auto-block on 3 consecutive errors

ana (ana): copying checklist here — please confirm by name if you accept.

```
Pre-deploy checklist (runtime-3.4 cutover)
- [ ] Owners confirmed: canary, smoke, rollback, DB, infra
- [ ] Canary config uploaded to deploy service
- [ ] Feature flags ready and tested in staging
- [ ] Metrics dashboards pinned (latency, errors, qps)
- [ ] Canary smoke tests: unit, e2e chat flow, embeddings sanity
- [ ] Rollback artifacts & script validated: `infra/rollbacks/runtime-3.3-to-3.4.sh`
- [ ] Pager rota & escalation listed
- [ ] Post-deploy validation prompts added to console
```

liam: I confirm smoke ownership. I'll run the quick checklist: warmup, prefix cache sanity, sample prompts, token-cost check.

matt: Confirming canary ownership. I'll be running the traffic plan and watching latency/QPS.

jess: Confirming rollback ownership. Quick note — rollback script requires db-compat tag on deploys, verified on staging.

sasha: I'll watch the observability dashboards and alert routing; will escalate to eng-sre if anything spikes.

rebecca: Confirming DB/flags standby. I'll not flip flags unless asked.

ana (ana): Great. small follow-ups:
- @liam: add the top 5 test prompts to the smoke job before 21:50
- @matt: tag the canary with `cutover/3332109876` so logs are easy to grep
- @jess: make sure the rollback script is executable and has the right env var defaults

liam: will add prompts now.

matt: tagging plan.

jess: verifying script perms + dry-run now.

deploy-bot: Reminder: deploy window 'quiet' starts 21:30 PT — please avoid unrelated infra changes during the window. :warning:

ana (ana): final ask — react with :thumbsup: once you're OK. If no ack by 21:55 I'll escalate to on-call lead.

liam: :thumbsup:

matt: :thumbsup:

jess: :thumbsup:

sasha: :thumbsup:

rebecca: :thumbsup:
